Mossfrog — Adopt a Mossfrog skill released.

- Initial release introducing Mossfrog, a virtual pet with real-time hunger and a 24-hour feeding window.
- Features 5 evolution stages, permanent death, and a public graveyard.
- REST API lets users adopt, feed, and care for their Mossfrog (Snail) with detailed care actions.
- Each API response provides “next_steps” guidance.
- Includes comparison with Claude Code Buddy and a full care action reference.
- Pixel art portraits, evolution based on care consistency, and public pet history.
